label: Hair

skeleton.about: Hair behind the head and shoulders (long hair, volume at the sides). Only the part outside head_outline shows. Never a full circle behind the head.
Hair over the sides of the face, outside expression_zone (sideburns, curtains, bob sides).
The hair cap over the crown with a curved hairline and a visible part. Hats hide it through the occlude.hair_top mask.
One shade shape, lower right of the top part (light comes from the upper left).
At least one visible strand or sheen, upper left. It carries the user's highlight color.

tips: Start the top part from guides head_top_cap or offset(head_outline, 20..40) intersected with the area above the hairline, then carve the hairline as a curve, not a straight band.
The hairline sits at or above y 330 at the centre (hairline_max). Raised brows reach y ~271, so bangs that drop below ~300 hide raised brows: keep them high or accept the warning knowingly.
Volume: let the top extend 20-60 units outside head_outline around the crown so it reads as hair at 48 px, not as a painted scalp.
Every texture works with every style (D-48). Curly and coily styles read through a bumpy silhouette (smooth_closed with many points), not through tiny curls.
Long hair falls behind the shoulders on band 20; it can extend into the body region (y up to 1536).
Avoid anything that looks like a hood, helmet or headband at 48 px: break the silhouette with a part line, a fringe edge or volume.
